title: Network Civilization, Platform Civilization and Data/AI Infrastructure
summary: As nodes and connections gain importance, civilizational structure extends beyond continuous territory. Platforms concentrate markets, identity, payment, reputation and information in digital carriers, while data and AI shorten the interval between observing reality, analyzing it and feeding decisions back into operation.

blocks.text: As nodes and connections gain importance, civilizational structure extends beyond continuous territory. Platforms concentrate markets, identity, payment, reputation and information in digital carriers, while data and AI shorten the interval between observing reality, analyzing it and feeding decisions back into operation.

This does not claim that platforms have become states or that AI will inevitably replace human governance. The focus is on which functions are migrating, which decisions require appeal and human responsibility, and how fast models remain inspectable and correctable.

This article provides structural observation rather than a ranking of civilizations. Future-capacity statements remain conditional; B6-WEB-B adds no live data and does not turn runtime readouts into outcome predictions.
